title: Well worth it!!!
text:
Yaya (not sure how you spell his name) was an excellent guide.  He spoke clearly and was very knowledgeable.  All the information provided was very interesting and also clear and understandable.  The tour proceeded at a steady pace, but a wealth of information was provided in simplified language.
The Basilica itself is AMAZING and a reflection of Gaudí’s brilliant mind and amazing spirituality.
We would not have been able to get the most out of our visit to the Basilica had we not done this tour, and I would highly recommend this tour to anyone who wants to visit the Sagrada Familia Basilica.

title: Unforgettable Sagrada Família Tour with Adelina!
text:
We had an absolutely wonderful guided tour (1.5h approx.) of the Sagrada Família with Adelina. She was incredible—so kind, warm, and exceptionally knowledgeable. What made the tour truly special was the way she pointed out all the intriguing, subtle symbols and hidden details throughout the basilica that we would have completely missed on our own. Her insights brought Gaudí’s masterpiece to life in such a fascinating way.
​If you are visiting Barcelona, booking a tour with Adelina is a absolute must. Thank you for making our visit so memorable!
